baseline.equivalence_test: The runner uses the stable DPR encoder, Wiki-DPR manager, and evaluator answer matcher while making no selector, scorer, generator, or label changes

core_invariants: The diagnostic retrieves exactly once per question at Top-200 and derives hit-at-50, hit-at-100, and hit-at-200 from that same ranked list.
The replication slice is nq_open validation[450:650], disjoint from Phase 9B and Phase 9C slices.
The prior Phase 9C compact result is consumed only after exact SHA-256 verification; the combined gate uses 400 disjoint rows.
Answer Scorer, select_passages, Generator, and evaluation metrics are not invoked or modified; gold answers are consumed only by the frozen matcher and never written to Exchange.
The stable token-boundary answer matcher is reused; only first answer rank and scalar cutoff flags cross the exchange boundary.
No diagnostic output can feed retrieval, selection, generation, or evaluation back into the runner.
Exchange output never contains question, passage, gold-answer, prediction, or raw-prompt fields.

interfaces.input_schema: one stable question ID, its gold answer strings, and one ordered Top-200 Wiki-DPR text list
interfaces.output_schema: stable question ID, nullable first_answer_rank, and boolean hit-at-50/100/200 flags
invariants: first_answer_rank is one-based and null only when no answer-bearing passage occurs by rank 200
cutoff flags are deterministic functions of first_answer_rank

interfaces.input_schema: compact per-question rank rows and frozen gate thresholds
interfaces.output_schema: cutoff hit/failure rates, rank bins, uncertainty intervals, and bottleneck classification
invariants: classification uses only compact rows and preregistered point thresholds
no raw text or answer strings are consumed by the combiner

plugins.insertion_point: after stable DPR query encoding and one Wiki-DPR Top-200 retrieval
plugins.hypothesis: The answer-bearing passage may be present beyond rank 50 even when the Phase 9B Top-50 ceiling fails.
plugins.input_schema: ordered Top-200 retrieved text sequence plus question ID and gold answers
plugins.resource_estimate: One DPR query encoding and one Top-200 Wiki-DPR lookup per question; no reader or LLM forward
failure_signatures: raw passage or question text is written to Exchange

plugins.insertion_point: after the new 200-row observer result and the SHA-256-verified Phase 9C compact result
plugins.hypothesis: A second disjoint validation slice will resolve whether the Phase 9C boundary result is sampling noise or a stable retrieval-depth pattern.
plugins.input_schema: two disjoint compact rank-row sets and frozen gate thresholds
plugins.resource_estimate: No model call; SHA-256 verification and scalar row concatenation
failure_signatures: prior artifact hash does not match the preregistered hash
question IDs overlap across the two slices

plugins.insertion_point: after compact rank rows are joined and validated
plugins.hypothesis: A substantial Top-200 gain over Top-50 identifies a candidate-depth cutoff; persistent Top-200 failure identifies retriever-limited coverage.
plugins.input_schema: compact rank rows and maximum-failure/minimum-gain thresholds
plugins.output_schema: cutoff_limited, retriever_limited, no_top50_ceiling, or mixed_or_inconclusive decision
plugins.resource_estimate: Scalar aggregation over at most 200 question rows; no model call
failure_signatures: Top-200 gain or failure threshold is not recorded
an answer-bearing rank is inferred from non-compact text after the observation boundary

composition.merge_rule: The observer emits one scalar row per question; the combiner verifies and joins two disjoint compact row sets; the gate consumes only those rows and cannot alter the retrieval call or any downstream component.
interaction_ablations: hit-at-50 versus hit-at-100 versus hit-at-200 from the same retrieval list
first-answer-rank bins versus aggregate cutoff rates
point-threshold classification versus uncertainty interval reporting

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixtures prove cutoff flags are exact deterministic functions of the first rank and the runner disables scorer, selector, and generator paths.
tests: replication slice and Top-200 configuration validation
prior artifact SHA-256 and disjoint-ID validation

reproducibility.dataset_identity: new nq_open validation questions 450-649 plus SHA-256-pinned Phase 9C rows for 250-449; Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, nprobe=64, one Top-200 DPR retrieval
reproducibility.environment: runner records Python executable/version, git revision, config SHA-256, plugin tree hash, encoder IDs, corpus config, rank cutoffs, and output paths

limitations: The answer-bearing test uses the frozen lexical token-boundary matcher and may miss aliases or semantic evidence.
The combined 400-question estimate reduces but does not eliminate sampling uncertainty.
A cutoff-limited result authorizes only a separate candidate-depth validation; it is not evidence that a selector or retriever change improves F1.
A retriever-limited result requires a separate retriever-change diagnostic with frozen evaluation boundaries.
